characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a rough‑spun woolen tunic in muted earth tones, frayed at the cuffs from years of use; over it she dons a sturdy brown leather apron with deep scuff marks along the shoulders and front panels where tools have brushed against it. A wide iron belt cinches her waist, holding a small pouch for oil cloths and a pocketknife. Her lower half is covered by simple linen breeches tucked into worn leather boots that reach mid‑calf, their soles polished but showing signs of frequent use on stone floors

characters.name: Goblin
characters.clothing: A rough‑spun light‑tan tunic with short sleeves that fits his small frame, belted at the waist by a worn leather belt holding several pouches for coins and tools; simple brown trousers tucked into scuffed leather boots; a dark mossy‑green hooded cloak draped over his shoulders to blend in with tavern patrons

characters.name: Elf
characters.clothing: A 35‑year‑old female elf wears a green‑tinted linen tunic embroidered in silver leaf motifs that drapes to her knees; the tunic is belted at the waist with a worn leather strap and carries faint wear from travel. Beneath, she sports fitted dark wool breeches tucked into soft leather boots reaching ankle level. Over her shoulders hangs a moss‑green velvet cape of modest length, fastened by a simple silver brooch. A delicate silver circlet sits just above her brow, complementing the long strands of silver hair that flow down to shoulder level; she also wears a matching thin silver necklace around her neck

characters.name: Dragon
characters.clothing: A sleek, black‑leather harness cinched snugly around its broad waist, featuring small brass buckles and two short pouches for carrying ale. The dragon’s head is adorned with a thin silver circlet that matches the obsidian hue of its scales
